notes.title: Viridion Island
notes.heading: Viridion Island
notes.content:
# Viridion Island

## Overview

A mysterious island on **Meldora**, central to the Reed family's history and to the trio of survivors whose children are the main characters.

- Located in the **middle of the ocean**, very far from any inhabited lands.
- **First** place struck by the Prionite comet; the island is made of comet material that fell from space.
- Thick fog surrounds the island and **cuts off all communication**; no discovery has been made and recording devices have never been retrieved.
- The island's biology is entirely comet-derived: every plant, animal, and microbe has been reprogrammed by the Prionite agent at extreme expression levels. The jungle is a dense, self-sustaining bioweapon.

## The Vault Chamber

At the island's center sits a sealed structure — the **Vault Chamber** — a building made of materials that predate any known human architecture. In the chamber's center is the **Prime Orb**: an Auri observation artifact (see [[Comet and Virus Origin]] for hidden truth).

### Function of the Prime Orb

- **Passive scan**: reads the cistron profiles of anyone who touches it.
- **Active infusion**: imprints a **latent dual-activation** — a second, dormant cistron pattern alongside the user's existing genetic profile. This pattern is expression-silent at the time of contact (hence the "no changes" result in tests); it transmits genetically to offspring and merges with whatever Lineage the child develops.
- **Return mechanism**: after imprinting, the orb returns the user to the island's surface unharmed. The mechanism is unknown to human observers.
- **Selectivity**: The orb has activated only for three humans so far — each in a team that was otherwise annihilated. It has **not** activated for Lewis Reed on his second visit (2010 CE), nor for any other expedition members who survived in large numbers. The trigger conditions are unknown; the island "behaves differently" on different visits.

## The Three Survivors

Three separate teams each produced **one survivor**. Their accounts describe how dangerous the island is and how they survived:

- Each explored the island from a **different section**.
- They faced **mutated beasts** and **Bloaters** (former humans from previous expeditions, now disfigured and instinct-driven).
- After every other team member died, each survivor was **teleported to the Vault Chamber** at the center of the island (not knowing where they were).
- The chamber was a single room; in the center stood the Prime Orb.
- Each touched the orb and felt a **warm feeling** (the latent dual-activation infusion).
- Scientists performed multiple tests afterward but found **no detectable changes** in them.

### Divergent Fates

- One **retired** and became a **manager** at a natural-resources company handling medicine R&D.
- One **kept working** for his organization and **rose to a high position**.
- Lewis Reed was **sent again in 2010 CE as captain**; the expedition failed, the team was annihilated, and Lewis was killed. He expected the Vault Chamber to save him again — but it did not. His dying thought: "Where's the room? Why haven't I been taken?"
- After 2010, attempts to explore the island became far fewer, but they **never stopped**.

## Confirmed Events — 2010 CE

Lewis Reed leads an expedition to the island. He has been there before and is the only survivor of the previous visit (one of the three original orb-survivors).

During the expedition:

- The island appears **changed** from Lewis's previous visit — the jungle is denser, more hostile, as if the Prionite agent has continued to intensify.
- Dense fog surrounds the island.
- The vegetation is twisted and overgrown; a mottled fungus pulses as if alive (bioaccumulated Prime expression in the plant tissue).
- Strange translucent-skinned creatures inhabit the jungle (mutated fauna at extreme Prionite expression).
- Mutated predators attack the expedition (multiple Lineage-analogues running through the fauna — enhanced physicality, sensory ambush behaviors).
- The entire visible team is killed.
- Lewis expects the teleportation mechanism to save him ("Where's the room?"); it does not.
- Lewis is killed by mutated creatures at the end of the prologue.

## The Main Characters

The three main characters are the **children of the three men who survived** the island. They will join the exploration team together — their journey to understand the island and the truth about how their world changed.

The island is calling to them not through choice, but through biology: the latent dual-activation their fathers received from the Prime Orb is stirring in their cistrons. When they return to the island and enter its high-Prime environment, their mutated abilities will begin to awaken — and once awakened, they may be beyond anyone's ability to control.

## Mysteries

- What is the island? (Auri observation site; primary Prionite seeding location)
- Why does it change? (The Prionite agent continues to evolve; the Vault Chamber may be influencing the island's biosphere)
- What happened during Lewis's previous visit? (He was the only survivor of his team; was teleported to the orb; received the latent activation)
- What is the Vault Chamber and the Prime Orb? (Auri artifact; observation + genetic imprinting tool)
- Why did the survivors feel a warm sensation with no detectable change? (The dual-activation was expression-silent; it transmits genetically)
- Why does the island behave differently on later visits? (Unknown trigger conditions for the orb's return mechanism)
- What is the source of the mutations? (The Prionite agent — but the hidden truth is that it was engineered by the Auri)
- How is the island connected to Kellan's abilities? (His father's latent activation merged with his own Lineage to create Vital Extraction)
- Why are the survivors' children drawn to it? (Their stirring cistrons and the island's high Prime concentration pull them)

notes.title: Vital Extraction
notes.heading: Vital Extraction (Healing Lineage — Mutated Dual-Activation)
notes.content:
# Vital Extraction (Healing Lineage — Mutated Dual-Activation)

**User:** [[Kellan Reed]]
**Lineage:** Healing (mutated — see [[Power System]] for full mechanism)

## Origin

Vital Extraction is not a separate ability — it is a **mutated expression** of Kellan's Healing Lineage, triggered by the latent dual-activation inherited from his father Lewis Reed, who carried a passive Prime infusion from the Viridion Island Prime Orb. It does not appear in any known Vironite lineage registry and is the first confirmed evidence that the three survivors of Viridion Island carry something other humans don't.

## Mechanism

Kellan's reprogrammed mitochondria can form temporary biochemical "bridges" with nearby organisms' Prime reserves, drawing Prime through the air via electrochemical gradients. The process:

1. **Initiation** — Kellan focuses on a living organism within ~10 meters and opens a Prime-encoded electrochemical channel (typically through extended palm or physical contact, though extreme distress can trigger involuntary activation at range).
2. **Extraction** — Prime flows from the organism to Kellan as an invisible current. The recipient experiences rapid energy depletion: plants wilt; small animals collapse; humans feel sudden exhaustion and disorientation.
3. **Conversion** — extracted Prime is integrated into Kellan's own mitochondrial reserves, immediately available to fuel Healing or other metabolic demands.

## Limits

- **Works best on flora and small animals** — their Prime architecture is simple, with no neurological counter-resonance; extraction is fast and complete.
- **Poor on humans** — the human Prime system is complex and actively resists extraction; the yield is minimal and the process is slow and exhausting. Ethically, this is Kellan's most troubling capability.
- **Range**: ~10 meters maximum; shorter at higher intensity.
- **Physical contact** is not required but significantly improves yield and reduces Kellan's own Prime cost during extraction.

## Costs

- **Shortness of breath** — the body simultaneously heals and processes foreign Prime; respiratory system is overtaxed during the dual metabolic load.
- **Cellular exhaustion** — accumulated Prime from multiple sources destabilizes mitochondrial function; prolonged extraction in a single session causes cumulative, hard-to-reverse fatigue.
- **Healing suppression** — overusing Vital Extraction temporarily suppresses Kellan's own Regeneration (the body prioritizes Prime integration over Cohesion maintenance). This is a dangerous window: Kellan heals, but is then left with no healing ability for hours.
- **Self-draining risk** — frequent overuse causes Kellan's mitochondria to begin consuming his *own* Prime reserves for healing rather than drawing from external sources. This is a Cohesion-collapse precursor and, if sustained, risks Bloater conversion.

## Practical Applications

- Emergency healing boost in battle (drawing from wounded enemies or surrounding vegetation)
- Sustained healing during prolonged operations when calories/medicine are unavailable
- Last-resort survival tool (extraction from the environment when Kellan is critically wounded and alone)

## Progression

TBD — the ability's true mechanics and full limits are only partially understood by Kellan and completely unknown to the scientific community. Its connection to the Prime Orb and Viridion Island is the central mystery of his arc.

# World History

> This file records the established in-universe history from the perspective of what characters know. The hidden Auri truth (see [[Comet and Virus Origin]]) is marked separately.

## Pre-Outbreak (Unknown Date — "Year Zero")

The Prionite comet — launched by the Auri Hegemony as a controlled mutagen experiment — strikes Meldora. The primary impact site is a remote ocean island later named **Viridion Island** ("green," after how its jungle grew). Fragments of the comet scatter across the world, carrying dormant Prionite agent capsules into the biosphere.

In-universe, this event is known simply as "the comet impact" or "the outbreak." The exact date is uncertain; in-world historians use a relative calendar (before/after the comet).

## The Outbreak (Years 0–10)

- The Prionite agent activates on contact with liquid water and biological tissue across the planet.
- **Cohesion outcomes vary**: some humans develop stable Lineages (Vironites); others are simply lucky to survive; a portion fail integration and become Bloaters. Animals and plants undergo parallel mutations.
- Mutated territories expand rapidly as Bloaters and enhanced fauna occupy uninhabited land.
- Human populations retreat into defensible **strongholds**, which eventually consolidate under large organizations.

## The First Survivors — Viridion Island (Unknown Date)

Three separate exploration teams are sent to Viridion Island — the primary impact site, the most dangerous location on the planet. All three teams are annihilated. Each team produces **one survivor**. Each survivor:
- Explored the island from a different section
- Faced mutated beasts and Bloaters (former members of prior teams)
- Was teleported to the **Vault Chamber** at the island's center after the deaths of their teammates
- Touched the **Prime Orb** in the chamber's center and felt a warm sensation
- Was returned unharmed; scientists found no detectable changes

The orb imprinted a **latent dual-activation** — a dormant cistron pattern that would only manifest genetically in the survivors' offspring, merged with whatever Lineage the child developed.

See [[Viridion Island]] for the full account.

## 2010 CE — The Lewis Reed Expedition

Lewis Reed — one of the three original orb-survivors — leads a new exploration team to Viridion Island. He is the only surviving member of his original team; he expects the Vault Chamber to save him again.

**Key events**:
- The island appears changed — denser jungle, more hostile fauna, fog thicker than any previous account.
- The team is attacked by mutated predators and overwhelmed.
- Lewis's telekinesis and his team's abilities (Empathy, Molecular Friction, Friction Manipulation, Toxin Consumption) are ineffective against the island's escalation.
- Lewis expects the teleportation mechanism; it does not activate.
- The entire team is killed. Lewis dies at the end of the engagement.
- The island's behavior on this visit differs from Lewis's first visit — a mystery.

See [[00 - Prologue]].

## 2010–2027 CE — Post-Expedition Period

- Exploration attempts to Viridion Island become far fewer but never stop entirely.
- Lewis Reed's son, **Kellan Reed**, grows up on the Drakonis Continent with questions about his father's death and his own unusual abilities.
- Kellan's healing (Regeneration) is far beyond normal Vironite capacity; his secondary ability, Vital Extraction, has no known precedent.
- Kellan joins the **Blade Order** and rises to Vice Captain by 2027 CE.
- The **Eternal Order** remains in active conflict with the Blade Order on Drakonis.

## 2027 CE — Eternal Order Infiltration

The Eternal Order infiltrates a Blade Order base on the Drakonis Continent. Roy Hardy is identified as a betrayer.

See [[01 - Chapter 1 - Kellan Reed]].

## Earlier History

TBD — dates of initial strongholds, organization formation, and the first recognized Lineage users.

## Hidden History (Author Note — Not In-Story)

The comet was engineered by the **Auri Hegemony** as a mutagen experiment. The Prime Orb is an Auri artifact. The three survivors' latent activations are producing uncontrollable abilities in their children — an unengineered variable that is triggering a **civil war** within the Auri Hegemony between the Sovereign Observers and the Reclamation Council. This conflict has not yet touched Meldora directly. See [[Comet and Virus Origin]].
